scope: 77 methods in root README model tables; scFM and benchmark rows excluded
score: Weighted Jaccard over curated architecture tags; family weights 3, autoencoder/diffusion parent 1, regulatory/factorization families 2, modules/details 1. Edges require at least one shared eligible family/module.
interpretation: Annotation-derived structural similarity, not measured functional similarity, performance, inheritance, or publication chronology.
